## Checklist

- [ ] I read and followed `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] The product uses AI as a core part of its publicly available product.
- [ ] The description is neutral, concise, and ends with a period.
- [ ] The commercial signal is labeled `Revenue`, `Customers`, `Funding`, or `Paid product` and does not overstate the source.
- [ ] The evidence link opens the page that supports the claim.
- [ ] The product is in alphabetical order within one category.
- [ ] I used no referral, affiliate, tracking, or shortened links.
- [ ] I searched the list and open pull requests for duplicates.
- [ ] I disclosed my relationship to the product above.
- [ ] I ran `npx --yes awesome-lint` locally.
